content.comment_body: Hello, I'm attempting to connect [product_name] software (version [version_no]) to my [product_name] PLC ([article_no]). The PLC appears on the network, but when I try to upload or download data, there’s no response. I can’t access the PLC settings online, and checking the firmware online gives a message stating "function not available", even though the connection seems fine in the settings. I tried this on both Windows XP and Windows 10 with the same result, so I suspect the issue is with the PLC itself. Any advice would be appreciated. Thank you.
It sounds like you might have a newer [product_name] PLC ([article_no], FS04). If that's the case, check this [url]: Why can't you download programs to your new [product_name]?
Thank you for the help. After downloading [product_name] version [version_no], everything is working correctly now.
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled: [product_name] software cannot upload the program to [product_name] device. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered issues with communication between [product_name] software (version [version_no]) and [product_name] PLC ([article_no]), despite the device being recognized on the network. The main challenge was the inability to upload, download, or access online settings, raising uncertainty about whether the problem was hardware, software, or configuration related. Updating to a newer software version resolved the issue, pointing to an underlying version compatibility concern that was not clearly communicated to users.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipated reliable upload/download operations and online access to PLC settings between their software and hardware, regardless of minor version changes. They expected basic compatibility and clear system messages indicating connection status or version conflicts.
